external_entities.name: Light Client
external_entities.description: Resource-constrained client requesting and verifying light client headers from full nodes

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail error handling behavior when block_to_light_client_header encounters a malformed execution payload.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the function requires a well-formed block as input and malformed payloads would have been rejected during block validation. This is an implicit precondition.

implicit_assumptions.description: The full node serving light client headers is assumed to compute Merkle proofs honestly.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious full node could provide fabricated execution payload headers with valid-looking but incorrect Merkle proofs, misleading light clients about execution layer state.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients are assumed to have access to the correct beacon block body root from a trusted source to verify execution branch proofs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without a trusted root, light clients cannot detect forged execution payload proofs.
